[[Fozzy Yeoryios]] is a [[Grawl Dark Priest]] [[boss]] who spawns in central-southern [[Sacnoth Valley]]. He is surrounded by a large number of [[Grawl]].

==Location==
* [[Charr Homelands]]
** {{NPC location|Sacnoth Valley}}

(20 [[Spawning Power]], 20 [[Communing]] in [[Hard Mode]])

* {{skill icon|Mend Body and Soul}}

* {{skill icon|Restoration}}

* {{skill icon|Soothing}}
* {{skill icon|Spirit Transfer}}

* [[Fozzy's Staff]] ([[Unique item|unique]])
* [[Grawl Trappings]]

==Trivia==
* His name is a reference to the GW [[w:machinima|machinima]] videos by the [http://www.fire-of-spirit.de.vu Fire of Spirit] [FoS] guild. A recurring character in these videos is a grawl named Fozzy by the guild, while 'Yeoryios' refers to Luke Yeoryios, the player who made and starred in the videos (and also appeared as the title character in [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8puR7ZMosEY 'The Kryta Bomber']).
